captionText: Meet Ripple. Ripple helps anyone check the health of a city stream.
piperText: Meet Ripple. Ripple helps anyone check the health of a city stream.

title: City streams tell a bigger story
captionText: Streams that run through our cities tell us about the health of the water, the wildlife, and the people around them.
piperText: Streams that run through our cities tell us about the health of the water, the wildlife, and the people around them.

title: One Health
captionText: This is the idea of One Health. Ecosystem, animal and human health are linked.
piperText: This is the idea of One Health. Ecosystem, animal and human health are linked.

title: Citizens can help
captionText: OneAquaHealth researchers need eyes on hundreds of urban streams, and citizens can help. Their checks reach researchers and support early warning.
piperText: One Aqua Health researchers need eyes on hundreds of urban streams, and citizens can help. Their checks reach researchers and support early warning.

title: Rebuilt for the water's edge
captionText: But the original app felt like a form built for scientists. So we rebuilt it around the person standing at the water's edge.
piperText: But the original app felt like a form built for scientists. So we rebuilt it around the person standing at the water's edge.

improvement: From a loading screen to a friendly welcome
beforeFact: Logo, then "Loading...", then a blank spinner
nowFact: "Your stream is part of city health"
captionText: Before, a logo and a loading screen. Now, Ripple welcomes you, and shows that your stream is part of city health.
piperText: Before, a logo and a loading screen. Now, Ripple welcomes you, and shows that your stream is part of city health.

improvement: Know why it matters before you start
nowFact: A Listen button on every screen
captionText: Five short screens explain why your check matters, with a safety reminder before you go. Tap Listen, and Ripple reads each one aloud in a natural voice.
piperText: Five short screens explain why your check matters, with a safety reminder before you go. Tap Listen, and Ripple reads each one aloud in a natural voice.

improvement: Your language, right to left included
captionText: Choose from eighteen languages, each honestly labelled while it awaits human review. Arabic reads right to left.
piperText: Choose from eighteen languages, each honestly labelled while it awaits human review. Arabic reads right to left.

captionText: Before, a raw error code. Now, a message anyone understands. Then pick an avatar that represents you and protects your identity.
piperText: Before, a raw error code. Now, a message anyone understands. Then pick an avatar that represents you and protects your identity.

improvement: Streams by name, on a water-first map
captionText: Streams appear on a water-first map, with a filter for the ones that need data. Then choose a nearby stream by name.
piperText: Streams appear on a water-first map, with a filter for the ones that need data. Then choose a nearby stream by name.

improvement: One question at a time, with pictures
beforeFact: Several questions on one long page
captionText: Questions come one at a time, with picture answers and a Listen button. And it's fine to say: I'm not sure.
piperText: Questions come one at a time, with picture answers and a Listen button. And it's fine to say: I'm not sure.

beforeFact: Three narrow columns of small text
captionText: Rate the stream's overall health. Each choice has an icon and a plain description.
piperText: Rate the stream's overall health. Each choice has an icon and a plain description.

captionText: Photos are optional. Each view says what to capture. Take a photo, or choose one from the gallery.
piperText: Photos are optional. Each view says what to capture. Take a photo, or choose one from the gallery.

nowFact: Your impact: checks, streams and photos
captionText: After you submit, Ripple celebrates and explains how researchers use your evidence. Your impact page counts every check.
piperText: After you submit, Ripple celebrates and explains how researchers use your evidence. Your impact page counts every check.

captionText: Your profile shows your details, your weekly rhythm and evidence badges. No leaderboards, no pressure.
piperText: Your profile shows your details, your weekly rhythm and evidence badges. No leaderboards, no pressure.

captionText: In Settings, gentle reminders nudge you about a stream you haven't checked in a while, at most once a week.
piperText: In Settings, gentle reminders nudge you about a stream you haven't checked in a while, at most once a week.

title: Same science. A much kinder way to take part.
captionText: Same science. A much kinder way to take part. OneAquaHealth Citizen Science: eighteen languages, read aloud, one friendly step at a time.
piperText: Same science. A much kinder way to take part. One Aqua Health Citizen Science: eighteen languages, read aloud, one friendly step at a time.
